title: columnea elongatifolia
intro: Columnea elongatifolia, commonly known as the 'Slipper Flower', is a species of flowering plant in the family Gesneriaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory health, and supporting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Columnea elongatifolia include antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, making it useful in treating various health conditions such as bronchitis and coughs. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
